purpose: Make the already-frozen Stage 3-5 capability qualification externally executable and harvestable without changing its model, interface, panel, thresholds or scientific decision rule.

expert_cell.obligation: keep model/interface qualification independent of any RAKL treatment outcome
bind exact repository subject, staged model revision, runtime module and output directory before sbatch
submission and harvest receipts are provenance only and cannot mint capability/scientific authority
no partial-run success, panel substitution, threshold change, model substitution or post-hoc repair may pass harvest

submission_contract: repository HEAD must equal exported SUBJECT_SHA
Stage3-5 freeze and panel-manifest git blobs must match the frozen identities above
sbatch must run the unchanged Stage-4 runner and exact staged model revision
submission receipt is written before outcome access and records job id, exact subject and frozen file hashes
no model substitution, network model download, interface repair or panel edit
harvest_contract: submission receipt subject must match the harvested job lineage
FINAL_CAPABILITY_RECEIPT must use the frozen model revision and panel SHA
all_132_cases_completed must be true for scientific capability/failure interpretation except typed RESOURCE_BLOCKED
only the Stage-5 runner decides CAPABLE_MODEL_AUTHORIZE_RECEIPT_V3 versus registered failure/resource terminals
forbidden_claims: submission or harvest provenance grants scientific authority
